title: Classify middle factors after an idempotent of any rank (no κ)
body:
**All middle factors are now parameterized for an idempotent first factor of any rank over F2.** For fixed A with A²=A, the ordered identity `(I+xA)(I+xB)(I+x(I+A+B))=I+xI` is equivalent to a construction from the A-invariant kernel of B and two maps on fixed complements. The proof gives an exact count and the full rank distribution at every dimension.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/verify.py) and [source credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/CREDITS.md).

For dimension four, the totals at first-factor ranks 0–4 are `802,296,188,184,316`. At rank two, **114 of the 188 solutions have both B and the third factor non-idempotent**. The rank-one exclusion therefore does not extend. The named rank-one count 296 and its fingerprint are prior results; they are repeated only as a source comparison.

**No new kappa.** These are formal polynomial matrices, not admitted paid calls. The selected value stays `363005817/100000000000` with all five assumptions. Native realization, preparation, storage, ownership, restoration, the complete signed invoice and recursive consumer remain unresolved. The result does not rebuild a paired-star word.

Canonical base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Card `joint-query-controller` changes scope to this algebraic alphabet classification; the [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19709190) records why. Phrase search identified the already completed rank-one question in [PR #7223](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7223) before work began. The new contribution is the all-rank kernel parameterization. Live Discussions, the closed cache and a fresh open-PR update delta were checked. The final full open-PR refresh timed out; the separate updated-order page covers every update after the retained snapshot. Sparse local notes and unpublished work remain overlap limits.

With CPython 3.12 and no third-party dependency:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/verify.py
```

Expected direct output:

```text
PASS_IDEMPOTENT_FIRST_FACTOR_KERNEL raw_matrix_cases=395316
```

Both registered modes pass. The 395316 raw matrix cases cover every middle matrix for all 14 canonical first factors through dimension four plus the named predecessor matrix. Direct polynomial multiplication agrees with a separate complete subspace-and-map construction, including each kernel, count stratum, rank distribution and idempotence class. The source fingerprint agrees exactly. Changed-C, non-idempotent-A, impossible-injection and wrong-kernel controls pass. The all-dimension conclusion comes from the written bijection, not extrapolation from this census.

AST and indentation checks, committed bytes and modes, source history, export input coverage, and an optimized sealed Git-free replay pass. The sealed source hashes and read-only modes stay unchanged. [Validation details](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/VALIDATION.md) separate the evidence from unrun checks. No complete predecessor suite, selected cold replay, native, Lean or Docker replay, independent human review or formal-kernel check was run. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44317272770/job/134846585992) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Credit @unpaidmoon for [PR #7223](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7223) at `7a17378d02117c956ca76b8106f35b15aa34c0dc`: its [proof](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7a17378d02117c956ca76b8106f35b15aa34c0dc/research/nonidempotent-middle-factor-1100/PROOF.md) supplies the coefficient criterion and named rank-one classification. Credit the same contributor's [PR #7040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7040) at `2bac9bfafe5fa009bce2141c07b703c977b18456` for the earlier [orthogonal and one-sided classification](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/2bac9bfafe5fa009bce2141c07b703c977b18456/research/rank1-idempotent-triple-1100/PROOF.md). Their notices disclose substantial Cursor Grok assistance and retain the earlier source lineage. Standard linear algebra supplies the subspace and complement counts. No predecessor code is copied. Prepared by Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

[Open next question](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/79ff656972d66915977e816b23ffdcef42fb0e12/research/idempotent-first-factor-kernel/README.md): can one classified higher-rank factor receive a fully charged native implementation in an actual caller? Its missing implementation and consumer contract block any saving claim. No follow-up is reserved.
